instruction: Fill in the blanks with the most appropriate words from the box. Don’t change the word forms. Word Bank: pros and cons, generate, primitive, accelerate, substitute, biodiversity, network, sort.

items.questionText: The use of wood in construction can be a controversial issue. On the one hand, it's a renewable resource, and its use can help _______________(1) less greenhouse gas emissions when it is compared to more energy-intensive materials like steel or concrete.

On the other hand, deforestation can lead to the loss of _______________(2), which is very important for the survival of a species and it can also cause the destruction of primitive cultures which make use of wood for their tools and construction of their houses.

On the other hand, deforestation can lead to the loss of biodiversity, which is very important for the survival of a species and it can also cause the destruction of _______________(3) cultures which make use of wood for their tools and construction of their houses.

If it is used responsibly and sustainably, wood can be an environmentally friendly choice. However, it's important to weigh the _______________(4) and if there are lots of drawbacks, other materials should be considered as a substitute for wood.
However, it's important to weigh the pros and cons and if there are lots of drawbacks, other materials should be considered as a _______________(5) for wood.
Regardless, deciding what _______________(6) of material to build out of is an important choice.
In our town, every year, we have a big parade to celebrate the local festival. The ____________(1) mayor used to lead the parade, but now it has changed.
The new practice is that we ____________(2) a different person each year to do it.
This year, the parade's main ____________(3) is to raise awareness about environmental issues.
One disadvantage of the parade is that it causes a lot of ____________(4). The traffic is so bad and the streets are so crowded that it's hard to move around.
To help with this, the city plans to ____________(5) certain streets from the parade route and to rotate the locations every year.
To help with this, the city plans to exclude certain streets from the parade route and to ____________(6) the locations every year.

Overall, the parade and the festival are a highlight of the year. Despite the ____________(7), most people look forward to this event because it brings the community together, helps to conserve traditions and provides an opportunity for everyone to have fun and celebrate.

Despite the obstacles, most people look forward to this event because it brings the community together, helps to ____________(8) traditions and provides an opportunity for everyone to have fun and celebrate.

instruction: The word in capitals at the end of each of the following lines can be used to form a word that fits in the blank space in the text. Fill in each space in this way. Spelling mistakes will be penalized.

items.questionText: Every year, the students at Greenfield High School vote for a new student council president. This year, many students are excited about the ___________(1) (ELECT).
However, critics say that the constant campaigning can cause ___________(2) among some students, especially if they are busy with project work, studying or preparing for exams (IRRITATE).
Maria, one candidate, promises to improve the school's recycling program and promote ___________(3) (CONSERVE).
Another candidate, Tom wants to help students manage their money by providing free classes on ___________(4) literacy (FINANCE).
Maria had to miss a few days of school due to illness, so her friend Alex acted as her ___________(5) (SUBSTITUTION).
The principal emphasizes ___________(6), believing being on time shows respect and helps everything run smoothly (PUNCTUAL).
At the end of the week, there is a big celebration. However, some students seem more interested in winning prizes, which others view as ___________(7) behavior (GREED).

instruction: Below you will find different meanings of the bolded word. Circle the one that matches the sentence.

items.questionText: I need to draw some money out of my account. (Word: account)

options.text: a written or spoken description of something that has happened
an arrangement in which a bank keeps your money safe so that you can pay more in or take money out
an arrangement that you have with a shop or company, which allows you to buy goods or use a service now and pay for them later

items.questionText: At present she's working abroad. (Word: present)

options.text: something that you are given, without asking for it, on a special occasion, especially to show friendship, or to say thank you
the form of the verb that is used to show what happens or exists now
a person being in a particular place

items.questionText: She wrote dull but respectable articles for the local newspaper. (Word: dull)

options.text: weather that is not bright and with lots of clouds
(for pain) not severe but does not stop

items.questionText: The organization has launched a campaign to raise $150,000. (Word: launched)

options.text: to make a computer program start
to send a weapon or spacecraft into the sky or into space
to make a new product, book etc. available for sale for the first time
to start something, usually something big or important

items.questionText: Lay the material flat on the table. (Word: Lay)

options.text: to put someone or something down carefully into a flat position
if a bird, insect etc. lays eggs, it produces them from its body
to put the cloth, plates, knives, forks etc. on a table, ready for a meal

items.questionText: All the people in the study had low self-esteem and had issues with their bodies. (Word: issues)

options.text: to have difficulty with something or a disagreement with someone
a set of newspapers or magazines published at the same time or a single copy of a newspaper or magazine
to make something seem more important than it should be, or to argue about it:
a new set of something such as shares or stamps, made available for people to buy

items.questionText: The body's regulation of temperature is essential for maintaining health. (Word: regulation)

options.text: A rule or directive made and maintained by an authority.
The act of managing or controlling something according to rules or principles.
A standard or regular measure or practice.
Rules or directives governing behavior or actions.

instruction: Fill in the blanks in the dialogue with words from the box. You do not need to change the form of the words. Word Bank: justice, unique, illustrate, ensure, launch, victims, reveal, sarcasm.

items.questionText: Samantha: It's basically a PSA on social __________(1) for our generation.
They're calling out past generations and warning us to take action and __________(2) a more just future for all.
Jake: That sounds powerful. What hidden facts do they __________(3) in the video?
Samantha: A lot of things. They show how our __________(4) position as digital natives allows us to raise awareness for important issues.
They also say that we can __________(5) effective campaigns to attract attention of the public.
When dealing with serious topics, we should communicate clearly, respectfully and avoid any hint of __________(6).
They also showcase statistics and stories from __________(7) of injustice, the people who suffer from unfair acts of others.
The video is a good tool to really __________(8) the severity of these problems to people who have never experienced such issues.
